item.title: Testport flooded as river overflows; 1,200 evacuated
item.description: Flood water covered much of the harbour city of Testport after the river overflowed. Officials said 1,200 people were evacuated and three shelters opened.

item.title: Parliament of Examplia approves water treaty
item.description: Lawmakers in Examplia approved a water-sharing treaty with neighbouring Samplestan by 140 votes to 60. The treaty covers the Blue River basin.

item.title: Researchers map seabed off Samplestan coast
item.description: A research vessel finished mapping 900 square kilometres of seabed off the coast of Samplestan. The survey took four weeks.
